item.title: Summer Session 3: More Tutoring Courses Added!
item.description: Wednesdays : 3-8pm (Ballroom, Student Union) Need some support with your summer classes? Drop by your TA’s office hours in the Student Union for extra help or book a one-to-one session with your TA. New tutoring courses added Diff Eq., MAU, Fluid Mechanics, Electronic Instrumentation, Linear Alg., and Eng. Dynamics! Book a One-to-One session with your TA. View the full Drop-In Tutoring Schedule

item.title: Road Closure – Peoples Avenue (Burdett Avenue to Sunset Terrace) – Friday, July 31
item.description:
Please be advised that on Friday, July 31, from 4:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Peoples Avenue will be restricted to construction vehicles only between Burdett Avenue and Sunset Terrace, including access to the Houston Field House and B-Lot/D-Lot areas. Limited parking and pedestrian access to ECAV and Harkness Field will be available via E-Lot off Sunset Terrace. Please allow extra travel time and follow all posted signage and directions while work is in progress.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
